patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.

options.description: The name shown under the app icon.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the app package name so the patched app installs alongside the original Threads. Set the desired package name in the patch options. WARNING: Meta apps hardcode many component/provider references — renaming the package can break Facebook login (SSO), content providers, or push. Disable this patch if you hit such issues.

options.description: The new application package name (e.g. com.instagram.barcelona.morphe).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from the Threads feed by filtering ad feed units (detected via Media.DED) out of the list merged into the feed cache, before they can render. Feed-scoped; other surfaces (clips/reels) are not affected.

patches.name: Remove AD_ID permission
patches.description: Removes the advertising-id (AD_ID) permissions so the device advertising id cannot be read for ad tracking. Does not disable Meta's core analytics.
